Texas ranks #5 of 51 tracked states (92th percentile) with 821 verified live revenue-role openings across 168 employers. State-average hiring aggressiveness is 71/100 with a active tier skew (47% of roles).

The market tilts toward Adjacent Revenue Roles (22% of reqs) concentrated in Remote-first (85%). Austin: vibrant, younger, music/tech crossover, collaborative. Dallas: professional, corporate, enterprise-heavy. Houston: diverse, international, energy-meets-tech. All hubs are pro-business with a 'get it done' attitude.

Massive SaaS migration - Dell, Oracle, Salesforce, HubSpot, and hundreds of funded startups in Austin.
